name: Interstice Pinring
description: Pass a shell hand to hand in the manner of the court so the receiver's grip and fuse are already checked.

name: Thunderclap Fragmentation
description: Throw a shell across a courtyard from a measured pace so the distance is known by the stride.

name: Steellever
description: Stand behind a colonnade pillar and turn with it so the burst finds only stone.

name: Reminiscence Fragment
description: Read the fuse by lantern light for the trueness of its spark before the shell leaves the pouch.

name: Thunderclap Spoon
description: Lob a shell from behind a partner who then turns to take cover in the same stride.

name: Dunespoon
description: Drop a shell from a gallery onto those below the rail so splinters fall back on the floor.

name: Tangling Lever
description: Run tripcords across a court so each foe's step arms a shell for the next to cross.

name: Solarcasing
description: Throw shells to ricochet from polished floor and pillar so bursts fall where the thrower cannot see.

name: Magma Concussion
description: Burst shells in mirror pairs on both sides of a hall so that no corner is out of reach.

name: Famed Cap
description: The school's dance of paired throws and steps and turns in which each partner lays bursts that strike the foe wherever he steps.

name: Pulsar Sizzle
description: Roll the shoulder like a hawk shrugging its wing and throw in the same turn.

name: Pealkaboom
description: Cup both hands like a basin to hold and steady the shell before the lift.

name: Kaboomgrace
description: Stoop low after the throw and rise on the other foot to reach cover.

name: Lifegiving Firecap
description: Read the fuse from a distance by the thin smoke it leaves in the air.

name: Gallant Fuse
description: Lob the shell so it comes to rest against the lip of a basin and bursts along it.

name: Thunderous Shrapnel
description: Throw as the body plunges and rises so the arm travels a longer arc than the stride.

name: Fuse Vow
description: Lean into the lift of a blast so the push passes over the shoulders.

name: Illustrious Casing
description: Throw quick volleys to fill the basin with bursts one after another in a falling pattern.

name: Vacuum Detonate
description: Dive from height and throw a flat hard shell at a marked point on a defended roof.

name: Thunderous Shockwave
description: Strike from a height and from the basin floor at once so bursts cross at the middle.

name: Triumphant Casing Crown
description: The school's closing method of hawk throws from above and basin throws from below that holds a hollow of ground against every foe.

name: Squall Shockwave
description: Step as two streams meet with one foot in each beat so the throw comes at the join.

name: Reminiscence Lever
description: Sight the point where two streams join and measure the throw from it.

name: Casinggift
description: Chant a river count under the breath so the fuse and the rhythm run together.

name: Unyielding Powderchamber
description: Dig the heels into a wet bank so the thrower's weight cannot slip at release.

name: Squall Spoon
description: Lob so the shell lands at the meeting of two streams where foes bunch to cross.

name: Dunekaboom
description: Throw so the bursts fall on both channels of a split stream in quick pair.

name: Inviolate Fragment
description: Drop into a backwater hollow after the throw so the bank itself shields from the burst.

name: Prismcasing
description: Set a shell upon a drifting log so the current bears it unseen to the foe's bank.

name: Tempestuous Powderchamber
description: Keep throws falling on both rivers at once so neither bank is safe.

name: Leverpledge
description: Lay shells along a weir so a foe wading across steps upon them.

name: Royal Kaboom
description: Time many shells to burst at the confluence in one instant so everything there is struck together.

name: Concussion Decree
description: The school's rite of timing fuses by river count so bursts fall along both banks in a fixed order that makes every crossing costly.

name: Revelation Firecap
description: Open the paired drill with a bow that fixes who throws first and who covers.

name: Gliding Sizzle
description: Step in echo of the partner a half-beat behind so the pair moves as one body.

name: Undaunted Cap
description: Crouch so the partner's body hides the shell as it is lit.

name: Famed Detonate
description: Throw as the partner's shell bursts so the foe finds no clear gap between them.

name: Radiance Shrapnel
description: Hand a lit shell over the shoulder to a partner who throws it without breaking stride.

name: Casingvoyage
description: Split from the partner to approach by two lines and meet again at the point of burst.

name: Inferno Fragmentation
description: Both throwers loft shells so two falls arrive on one spot a heartbeat apart.

name: Artful Shrapnel
description: The pair lays shells on two sides of a yard so any foe leaving it meets a burst.

name: Imperial Sizzle
description: Both throwers drive hard shells at one point so the bursts break a defended post.

name: Triumphant Magma Cap
description: The school's rite in which two throwers work as one court and each lays bursts that the other's bursts complete.

name: Luminous Casing
description: Scan the whole field with the qi field and the eyes together before choosing any mark.

name: Statute Spoon
description: Settle on a high place with the weight low and the qi field spread to feel the whole height.

name: Prismcap
description: Hold the shell ready until the foe's step fixes and release in that pause.

name: Paramount Concussion
description: Drop the shell to a single marked point seen through a gap in cover.

name: Revelation Lever
description: Feel the fuse burn through the qi field so the count needs no eyes.

name: Sizzlesolace
description: Move to a new perch between throws so the foe cannot find where the shells come from.

name: Reminiscence Fuse
description: Loose a short sharp cry as the shell is lobbed to turn every head the wrong way.

name: Magmasizzle
description: Rain shells from a high perch onto a far mark in steady rhythm without moving the feet.

name: Exalted Shockwave
description: Throw a hard flat shell through a narrow gap picked by the field's sense to burst behind a shield line.

name: Quenched Fragment
description: Choose one mark above all others and send one shell with full qi onto it when the field shows it unguarded.

name: Vaunted Season Pinring
description: The school's doctrine of watch and throw in which one grenadier holds a field under his eye and answers each movement with a burst.

name: Peal Pinring
description: Let the formed core settle the palm so the shell stays motionless however the body turns.

name: Pealcasing
description: Read the sky and the weather before a throw for what they will do to the flight.

name: Unwavering Powderchamber
description: Stand with the feet set in basin shape so no force from the throw leaks into the ground.

name: Bedrock Firecap
description: Walk at the pace of a deep river so the thrower never hastens or lags.

name: Pulsarcasing
description: Drive the shell far with qi from the core in one smooth surge of the whole body.

name: Sovereign Sizzle
description: Roll shells along a hollow's rim so bursts mark the whole circle one after another.

name: Wraithlike Detonate
description: Dive into running water after the throw and be carried clear of the foe's answer.

name: Despotic Firecap
description: Cast shells high so their smoke hangs in a veil that blots the foe's line of sight.

name: Demolition Detonate
description: Throw in a flowing run so burst after burst fills a basin and drains toward its outlet.

name: Sigil Powderchamber
description: Plant a shell and fix it with core qi so it bursts only when the foe's weight rests upon it.

name: Vaunted Kaboom
description: Time bursts from above and from the basin and the stream so all three arrive on one point together.

name: Casingedict
description: The school's highest rite of throwing in which sky and basin and river bursts are woven into one standing fall over a battlefield.
